rows.grounds: gerundive of dhṛ; sandhi before cakraṃ
first person agent; sandhi fusion with following dya (me adya)
adya shortened in sandhi after me'

items.question: What object must be held constantly today to accomplish the pacification of all misfortunes?
premises: The discus is the object designated to be held.
The holding is to be performed by the speaker today and always.
Holding the discus serves the purpose of pacifying all misfortunes.
items.inference: Therefore the discus must be held constantly today for the pacification of all misfortunes.
uncertainties: The exact referent of cakraṃ in this ritual context is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: The discus is to be held by me always, today, for the pacification of all misfortunes.
